text:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling for the PostFlight webinar launch/social push. Need final asset drop + CTA variants by EOD tomorrow. Reg link: https://redwood.ai/postflight

jamie: got it. which time windows are we targeting for X & LinkedIn?

maria: X: Mon 9:00 PT (tease), Wed 11:00 PT (live sign), Thu 9:00 PT (reminder). LinkedIn: Tue 10:00 PT (long-form), Thu 12:00 PT (exec post). can we shrink to two posts per channel?

olivia: can do two per channel. who's owning thumbnails + 3 quote cards?

ellie: design can deliver thumbnails + one static hero + 3 quote cards by tomorrow 6pm PT. need copy + one headline per card.

maria: love it. copy drafts — short and long below. pick A/B.

jamie: A: "We built Redwood PostFlight to make LLM inference predictable. Join our live demo — register: https://redwood.ai/postflight"

jamie: B: "Latency, cost, reliability — see Redwood PostFlight in action. Live webinar + benchmarks. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/postflight"

olivia: prefer B for LinkedIn, A for X. also request 2 CTAs: "Register" and "Save my seat".

maria: FYI running a benchmark narrative snippet: "up to 3x lower cost at 50ms median latency vs baseline" — ok to use?

ellie: that's marketing claim; legal signoff required. tagging @tariq for compliance.

tariq: looks ok but need source slide and internal benchmark doc link before approval. share by EOD.

maria: ETA for final copy + benchmark slide?

jamie: I'll finalize copy by 5pm, will drop benchmark slide in drive (link to follow).

ellie: scheduling note — please fill out this snippet for the scheduler:

```
channel: X
post_time: 2026-04-06T09:00:00-07:00
copy_variant: A
asset: hero_v3.png
```

olivia: I'll queue two follow-up DM templates for replies and inbound leads (short response + link to cal/lead sheet).

maria: perfect. After the first post, ops-bot will ping #growth for engagement push. @ops-bot can you confirm?

ops-bot: scheduled ping set: channel=#growth at 9:30 PT on 2026-04-06.

jamie: thanks. last ask — can someone own thread replies for the first 2 hours?

olivia: I can. will capture leads to the sheet and flag high-value replies.

maria: thanks all — will share final thread here when assets are uploaded :thumbsup:
